description:
Based on FAR 19.1306 HUBZone sole source set-aside awards, the Department of Justice,

Washington DC intend to procure via single source from Potomac Restoration, Inc. services

to repair cobble stones in the D and E courtyards at 950 Pennsylvania Avenue, NW,

Washington, DC  20530.

Contracting Office Address:

Department of Justice

145 N Street NE,

Washington, DC  20530

This notice is not a request for quote.  No solicitation document is available. No contract will be awarded on the basis of offers received in response to this notice.    POC: Dante Lewis, Contracting Officer, dante.lewis@usdoj.gov.
